crossRefs.note: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

translations.web: lest you learn his ways, and ensnare your soul.
translations.bsb: or you may learn his ways and entangle yourself in a snare.
translations.kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
translations.asv: Lest thou learn this ways, And get a snare to thy soul.
